errors.evidence: The reference states that the second sector is gray and represents 26.2%, but the machine description does not mention that it is represented correctly.
The description does not mention that the orange sector has a greater share than the blue sector, as stated in the reference.
The description does not mention the y-axis units (percentage) or that the percentages are written inside their respective sectors for all segments.
